nodes.label: Effective-price rule
nodes.rationale: A product with zero variants is priced by BasePrice; a product with variants is priced by ProductVariant.Price and BasePrice is suppressed so a customer is never shown a price they cannot buy at.

nodes.label: Single-flag invariants enforced in three layers
nodes.rationale: Entity owns the boolean, repository performs atomic transactional swap, PostgreSQL partial unique index is the final arbiter, preventing two rows claiming to be default.

nodes.label: Deterministic cryptographic idempotency
nodes.rationale: SHA256 KeyHash and RequestHash with a DB unique index on (TenantId, KeyHash) give multi-instance-safe idempotency without distributed locks, avoiding duplicate orders under retries.

nodes.label: ADR 0009: Payment Obligation vs Payment Attempt Model

nodes.label: Payment obligation vs payment attempt separation
nodes.rationale: One Payment aggregate per order with sequential immutable PaymentAttempt records models retries without creating competing obligations, keeping order and payment lifecycles decoupled and amounts server-authoritative.
nodes.norm_label: payment obligation vs payment attempt separation

nodes.label: ADR 0010: Pivot to Control Plane
nodes.rationale: Full pivot from shared multi-tenant SaaS to a control plane managing independent Django stores, executed as a strangle rather than a rewrite; supersedes ADRs 0001-0004 in part.

nodes.label: ADR 0011: React + Vite + TypeScript Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Chose React 19 + Vite + TypeScript static SPA over Next.js for a purely authenticated internal dashboard, avoiding SSR/token complexity; Persian-first RTL. Supersedes 0003.

nodes.label: ADR 0012: Store Authentication Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Each store gets a clientId+clientSecret exchanged at handshake for a short-lived (~30 min) store token scoped to one storeId and environment; rotatable credentials with a dual-active grace window, mTLS as future upgrade path.

nodes.label: ADR 0013: Error Grouping Strategy
nodes.rationale: Normalised fingerprint over storeId, environment, exceptionType, normalisedStackTop and endpointTemplate; version excluded so a problem persists across deployments. Ingestion upserts ErrorGroup and appends bounded ErrorEvent samples.

nodes.label: ADR 0014: Features as Deployable Packages
nodes.rationale: A Feature is a versioned, signed, immutable Django package delivered by KNIGHT, not an entitlement flag; entitlement and installation become two distinct tracked concepts. A capability is built once and delivered to any store that buys it.

nodes.label: ADR 0015: Feature Delivery Mechanism
nodes.rationale: An agent polls KNIGHT over outbound HTTPS for narrowly-typed jobs (never command strings) and verifies sha256 digest and detached signature before executing, avoiding making KNIGHT a remote shell or downloading unauthenticated code.

nodes.label: ADR 0016: Feature Migration and Removal Policy
nodes.rationale: A Feature owns migrations only in its own app label; mandatory expand/contract for destructive changes makes most upgrades reversible in practice; a backup/snapshot reference is recorded before migration since automatic DB rollback is often unsafe.
nodes.norm_label: adr 0016: feature migration and removal policy

nodes.label: ADR 0017: Feature Compatibility and Dependencies
nodes.rationale: Semantic versioning for Features and store applications; immutable published FeatureVersion corrected by yanking; manifests declare compatibility and dependency ranges resolved transitively in KNIGHT before any job is created.

nodes.label: ADR 0018: Separate Control-Plane Context and Access Module
nodes.rationale: A separate ControlPlaneDbContext on its own control schema plus a new AccessControl module, built alongside the frozen legacy context; customer isolation enforced as a fail-closed global query filter over ICustomerScoped.
nodes.norm_label: adr 0018: separate control-plane context and access module

nodes.label: ADR 0019: Entitlement as an Explicit Record
nodes.rationale: FeatureEntitlement is an explicit record with a source (Plan|Optional|Grant), reconciled idempotently from the subscription; manual grants are outside reconciliation so they survive plan changes. Enables out-of-plan grants, time-boxed grants and history.
nodes.norm_label: adr 0019: entitlement as an explicit record

nodes.label: ADR 0020: Store Ingestion Authentication
nodes.rationale: Implements 0012: a store presents a short-lived JWT (principal_type=store) from handshake; the token is not revocable so made not worth stealing while the credential behind it is; store principal carries no permissions and is refused by every dashboard policy.

nodes.label: ADR 0021: Domain Verification Before Connected
nodes.rationale: Domain ownership is proven separately (well-known HTTP token or DNS TXT) before a store reaches Connected, because a credential proves who calls but nothing about who answers on the domain; every outbound call is checked at the socket.

nodes.label: ADR 0022: Realtime Subscriptions Are Server-Assigned
nodes.rationale: SignalR groups are assigned on connect from the connection's own claims in OnConnectedAsync, with no client-callable Subscribe method, because a client-chosen customer id would silently leak live operational detail across customers.

nodes.label: ADR 0023: A Ported Store Is Single-Tenant
nodes.rationale: Porting the frozen .NET modules to Django drops TenantId entirely; the isolation boundary moves from a column to a database, avoiding a vestigial always-satisfied filter that looks like a security model and is not.
nodes.norm_label: adr 0023: a ported store is single-tenant

nodes.label: ADR 0024: Base Store Versus Optional Feature
nodes.rationale: A capability is base if a store cannot function commercially without it; everything else is a Feature. Revised 2026-08-25 to move promotions and delivery zones into the base store without changing the rule.
nodes.norm_label: adr 0024: base store versus optional feature

nodes.label: ADR 0025: Provisioning Is a Job With Manual Steps
nodes.rationale: A ProvisioningJob models the whole pipeline and marks each step with who carries it out; manual steps are real steps that hold the run in an explicit waiting-for-a-person state, so stuck stores are visible rather than hidden in a ticket.
nodes.norm_label: adr 0025: provisioning is a job with manual steps

nodes.label: ADR 0026: KNIGHT Records Backups, It Does Not Take Them
nodes.rationale: KNIGHT holds reports about backups, never backups or a route to the data, honoring rule 3; a success report with no size is refused, failures raise backup.failed and an overdue sweep raises backup.overdue.
nodes.norm_label: adr 0026: knight records backups, it does not take them

nodes.label: ADR 0027: The Restore Drill Is the Backup Test
nodes.rationale: The restore drill runs in CI on every push, restoring a real backup into a scratch database under pg_restore --exit-on-error and comparing tables, exact row counts, EF migration history and constraints, because an unrestored backup is indistinguishable from a working one.
nodes.norm_label: adr 0027: the restore drill is the backup test

nodes.label: ADR 0028: Staged Rollouts With a Single-Store Canary
nodes.rationale: A fleet-wide version change is a first-class rollout of ordered waves of targets; the canary is exactly one store never a percentage, a wave waits for the prior to report on every store, and a failed canary halts the rollout regardless of threshold.
nodes.norm_label: adr 0028: staged rollouts with a single-store canary

nodes.label: ADR 0029: One Slug for the Catalogue and the Package
nodes.rationale: The commercial catalogue is seeded with the slug the deployable package declares, closing a gap where the thing sold and the thing shipped had no name in common and nothing could be delivered against a freshly seeded KNIGHT.
nodes.norm_label: adr 0029: one slug for the catalogue and the package

nodes.label: ADR 0030: What Store Data May Reach a Model Provider
nodes.rationale: Only aggregates that a KNIGHT-authored function computed may leave the store to a model provider (exactly what providers.redact() produces), because a store's analytics stream could contain personal data and KNIGHT cannot send raw events to a processor the shop did not choose.
nodes.norm_label: adr 0030: what store data may reach a model provider

nodes.label: ADR 0031: Database Extensions Are Declared, Not Migrated
nodes.rationale: CREATE EXTENSION is a shared database change, not a Feature's own-table migration; declaring extensions (not migrating them) prevents a rollback from dropping an extension another Feature still depends on. Amends 0016.
nodes.norm_label: adr 0031: database extensions are declared, not migrated
